ability.ability_members_visible_text: Almost everything a Player Character does is affected by his abilities: Strength (STR), Dexterity (DEX), Constitution (CON), Intelligence (INT), Wisdom (WIS), and Charisma (CHA). Play Tabletop RPGs

fortification_scope.standard_item_rule_visible_text: Items are the primary source of fortification for most player characters. Standard fortification items provide enhancement bonuses to fortification. Multiple effects do not stack with each other. You can combine them with rarer Insightful Fortification items (insight bonus). Item effects fully stack with the racial fortification, enhancements, or epic destiny perks. Support Veterans

The trailing Support Veterans text is retained literally and is not a rule. No stacking-rule provenance or scope is changed.
